description: Sends the eng workflow contract and the core writing rules at session start and after each compaction, and enforces the workflow: nothing is posted; commits, pushes, PRs and issues go only through their skills, and not when your latest message says not to; risky remote writes, such as a delete, share, send, deploy or merge, ask first, while plain edits through MCP tools are left to Claude Code's own permissions; changed code gets a review reminder before hand-back; a push or a new PR gets a reminder to review the whole PR; and under a plan you approved, a push or a new PR asks off the plan's branch or through any tool but Bash, and on that branch through Bash or a shell tool is denied for a tree the review did not read, and the stop after it keeps the PR's review going.
